binarySearch :: Int -> Int -> Int -> [Int] -> Int
binarySearch lo hi target a
    | lo >= hi    = -1
    | otherwise   = case mid of
        m | a !! m < target -> binarySearch (m + 1) hi target a
          | a !! m > target -> binarySearch lo m target a
          | otherwise       -> m
    where
        mid = lo + (hi - lo) `div` 2
